footnote_text: In connection with the vesting and settlement of restricted share units ("RSUs") through the issuance of Class A shares of WaterBridge Infrastructure LLC (the "Issuer") pursuant to the WaterBridge Infrastructure LLC Long-Term Incentive Plan, the Issuer withheld Class A shares that would otherwise have been issued to the Reporting Person to satisfy their tax withholding obligations.
